interpolation: bilinear interpolation of real Terrarium pixel-center elevations

tags.description: Ego Bowl is the main Green that runs from near the top of Emerald Express Chairlift down through this area to the bottom of the Emerald Express Chairlift.
tags.name: Ego Bowl

tags.description: The School Yard is a short, wide Green that starts on the right side (looking downhill) of Ego Bowl (Green) and runs down to the bottom of the Emerald Express Chairlift.
tags.name: School Yard

tags.description: Orange Peel is a short Blue that runs from the top of Garbanzo Express Chairlift, meets with Pony Trail (Green) and then continues to end on Upper Dave Murray Downhill (Black).
tags.name: Orange Peel

tags.description: Dave Murray Downhill - Lower is a big, long Black run from Expressway (Green) all the way down to Creekside base.
tags.name: Dave Murray Downhill - Lower

tags.description: Bear Cub is a long, flat Green that runs from the bottom of Franz’s Chairlift down to the Big Red Express Chairlift base area.  This lower section runs from Pony Trail - Middle down to the bottom of the Big Red Express Chairlift.
tags.name: Bear Cub - Lower

tags.description: Olympic - Lower is the main Green run down to Whistler Village base.   It is wide, easy and groomed.
tags.name: Olympic - Lower

tags.description: Ptarmigan is a long Blue that runs from the right side of Raven down to end at the top of the Olympic Chairlift.
tags.name: Ptarmigan

tags.description: Crabapple runs down from Expressway through the Lower Frontend of Whistler and ends down on Lower Olympic near the Village.   This middle section runs from near the top of the Fitzsimmons Express Chairlift to Olympic - Lower.
tags.name: Crabapple - Middle

tags.description: Emerald Forest is a wide Blue that starts from the Chickpea Hut area and goes down to Ego Bowl (Green).    Enchanted Forest has a secondary start at the bottom of Pig Alley (Green) which drops down to connect with the main run below.
tags.name: Emerald Forest

tags.description: Lower Whiskey Jack is a long, wide Green that runs from the Chickpea Hut area (below the top of Garbanzo Express Chairlift) down to connect with Upper Olympic (Green) near the Emerald Express Chairlift base.
tags.name: Lower Whiskey Jack

tags.description: Tokum is a Blue that starts on the right side (looking downhill) of the Dave Murray Downhill (Black) and runs over to the Garbanzo Express Chairlift base area.
tags.name: Tokum

tags.description: Bear Paw is steep Black that starts off the right side (looking downhill) of Upper Dave Murray Downhill (Black) and runs down to Garbanzo Express Chairlift base.
tags.name: Bear Paw

tags.description: Old Crow is a short Blue that runs from the left side of Lower Whiskey Jack down to end on Lower Whiskey Jack (Green) further downhill.
tags.name: Old Crow

tags.description: Crossroad is a narrow Blue that runs from Expressway (Green), under the Creekside Gondola and over to connect with Franz's - Middle run (Blue)
tags.name: Cross Roads

tags.description: Sidewinder is a long, flat Green that runs from the bottom of the Harmony Express Chairlift over to the bottom of the Emerald Express Chairlift.
tags.name: Sidewinder

tags.description: Goats Gully is steep, bumpy Black mogul run that drops from Bear Cub (Green) down to the bottom of Big Red Express Chairlift.
tags.name: Goat's Gully
tags.piste:name: Goat's Gully

tags.description: Foxy Hollow is a wide flat Green that runs from the top of the Olympic Chairlift down to the the Whistler Gondola Mid Station.  This run is one of the 2 main runs through the learning area.
tags.name: Foxy Hollow

tags.description: Olympic - Upper is the big, wide main Green that runs from Emerald Express Chairlift base down to the Olympic Mid Station area (where it connects with Lower Olympic (Green) that leads into the village).
tags.name: Olympic - Upper

tags.description: Lower Dave Murray Downhill is a big, long Black run from Expressway (Green) all the way down to Creekside base.
tags.name: Fallaway Bypass

tags.description: Enchanted Forest Adventure Zone is a glade area between Ego Bowl (Green) and Emerald Forest (Blue) run.  There are several paths cut through it for kids to be able to ski through the glade area with safety (Blue difficulty).
tags.name: Enchanted Forest Adventure Zone

tags.description: Bear Cub is a long, flat Green that runs from the Franz’s Chairlift base area across the side of the mountain and then zig zags down to the Big Red Express Chairlift base area.
tags.name: Bear Cub

tags.description: This is an unmarked Black “run” under the Garbanzo Express Chairlift.  It is ungroomed with big bumps, drops, cliffs and steep sections.
tags.name: Garbonzo Express Chairlift Line

tags.description: The lower half of Insanity is a Double Black that runs from the top of the Creekside Gondola down under the Gondola, crosses Cross Roads (Blue) and ends down on the Dave Murray Downhill run (Black).
tags.name: Insanity

tags.description: The upper half of Insanity is a Double Black runs down from Pony Trail (Green), under the Big Red Express Chairlift to Big Red Express Chairlift Base.
tags.name: Insanity

tags.description: Bear Paw is steep Black that starts off the right side (looking downhill) of Upper Dave Murray Downhill (Black) and runs down to Garbanzo Express Chairlift base.
tags.name: Bear Paw

tags.description: Lower Olympic is the main Green run down to Whistler Village base.   It is wide, easy and groomed.
tags.name: Lower Olympic

tags.description: Fitz is a short Green that runs down from behind the top of the Fitzsimmons Express Chairlift to join with Lower Olympic (Green).
tags.name: Fitz

tags.description: Dave Murray Downhill - Upper is a big, wide Black run that starts just below the top of Garbanzo Express Chairlift and runs down to Expressway (Green) where it turns into the Lower Dave Murray Downhill (Black).
tags.name: Dave Murray Downhill - Upper

tags.description: This is a short Blue that connects to the bottom of Olympic - Lower to Crabapple - Lower.
tags.name: Crabapple Connector

tags.description: 4.6 is an alternative exit from grand finale, often used when Slalom race training is taking place
Raven is short Black run immediately to the left (looking downhill) of the top of the Garbanzo Express Chairlift.   It runs down to connect with Ptarmigan (Blue).
tags.name: Raven

tags.description: Orange Peel is a short Blue that runs from the top of Garbanzo Express Chairlift, meets with Pony Trail (Green) and then continues to end on Upper Dave Murray Downhill (Black).
tags.name: Lemon Peel

tags.description: Crabapple runs down from Expressway through the Lower Frontend of Whistler and ends down on Lower Olympic near the Village.   This upper section runs from Expressway to near the top of the Fitzsimmons Express Chairlift.
tags.name: Crabapple - Upper

tags.description: Crabapple runs down from Expressway through the Lower Frontend of Whistler and ends down on Lower Olympic near the Village.   This lower section runs from Olympic - Lower and then ends down on Olympic - Lower further down the hill.
tags.name: Crabapple - Lower

tags.description: Bear Cub is a long, flat Green that runs from the bottom of Franz’s Chairlift down to the Big Red Express Chairlift base area.  This upper section runs from Franz's Chairlift down to Pony Trail - Middle.
tags.name: Bear Cub - Upper

tags.description: Seppo's - Lower is an ungroomed Blue that runs from the bottom of Seppo's (where it meets Ptarmigan) down to Expressway just above the bottom of the Garbanzo Express Chairlift.
tags.name: Seppo's - Lower

tags.description: Bean Sprout is a short Blue that starts at the bottom of Chipmunk / on the side of Ego Bowl and curves down to end at the bottom of the Emerald Express Chairlift.
tags.name: Bean Sprout

tags.description: Ptarmigan is a long Blue that runs from the right side of Raven down to end at the top of the Olympic Chairlift.
tags.name: Ptarmigan

tags.description: Pony Trail is the main Green that runs in a large S curve down from Roundhouse Lodge area down to Big Red Express Chairlift base.  This upper section runs from Roundhouse down to Papoose.
tags.name: Pony Trail - Middle

demDataDate: historical multi-source DEM; source dates vary
coverageNote: 社区映射的已采集范围内雪道片段，非完整官方雪场模型；无缆车、建筑或实时雪面实测。
coverageEnglish: All non-area downhill ways in the saved bounded OSM response; not a complete official resort model.
